status_at_freeze: Controlled auto-escalation replay: same v40 science and full-resolution fallback, with an intentionally exhausted microsecond fast budget. Verify automatic escalation, complete fast-failure provenance, original remaining deadline, full-resolution recovery and source/reduction parity. This is a negative resource control, not a performance result.
scope: exposed, prior-assisted raw-frame-to-PhaseSmith-search regression; no atomic coordinates/counts or archived measurements supplied to numerical worker

acquisition.angle_provenance: Previously adopted provisional contiguous 0.5 degree exposures; HDF5 has no spindle-angle metadata. Omega-zero is a gauge, sign/step remain declared assumptions.

prediction.competing_exclusions: measured track centres only; no full lattice enumeration from provisional competing cells

reduction.assumptions: Declared horizontal polarization and neutral detector efficiency; no diamond absorption, vendor transfer factors or atomic-model correction. Shape/scaling references use complete training families.
reduction.edge_centres: Retain excluded records; omit only pre-existing EDGE rows outside [0,width-1]x[0,height-1] before profile learning/reduction. Mesh limits and quality gates unchanged.

search.resource_reason: 128 MiB explicitly covers the input-derived volume atom cap for full q<=2 raw predictions, whose observed coverage can exceed the archived HKL subset; no reference count used
search.time_reason: Single predeclared longer-time diagnostic: allow all unchanged 800-cycle starts to finish; seed, trials, data, phase-origin threshold and scientific gates unchanged.

execution_policy: Fresh output only. Preserve every first-stage outcome and failure. No seed/configuration selection by reference or R1. Commit protocol before reading frames. Reference grading happens after chosen candidate is saved.

measurement_validity.frame_validity: Shared per-frame illumination mask; native integration/profile quality and finite-support flags remain authoritative.
measurement_validity.criterion: Centre eligibility additionally queried from same pixel mask; partially blocked rocking profiles remain flagged by masked native sample support. No fixed DAC centre-angle cut.
measurement_validity.provenance: Unchanged default illumination estimator plus v5 declared aperture geometry, now applied as shared whole-exposure pixel masks. All model/threshold/coordinate gates remain frozen; all earlier outcomes preserved.
measurement_validity.flag_policy: Retain MISMATCH warning with original values; all other profile/integration flags still exclude. No export significance cut.

shadow_mask.policy: OR the unchanged source-count illumination mask and the explicitly known/assumed DAC cone already used in v5. Entire exposure/16x16 block footprint must be unblocked. Coarse geometric blocks are conservative, explicit and fingerprinted. No centre-only DAC selection or structure-based mask fitting.

io.orientation: original native array; existing declared vertical flip exactly once in example loader
io.scope: Rust-only file input, numerical workflow coordination and output; optional independent grading follows executable exit.

geometry_backend: phasesmith-spots native bounded soft-L1 geometry fitter
profile_fitting_backend: phasesmith-spots native bounded L-BFGS-B: ten secant pairs, dense generalized Cauchy/free-subspace quadratic, More-Thuente line search, analytical fused shape partials, fixed outer noise iterations and native joint sigma
empirical_scaling_backend: phasesmith-spots native bounded damped least squares and family-mean elimination/Huber IRLS

numerical_equivalence.note: Unchanged strict equivalence targets inherited from v10/v9. Compare v11 with preserved v9; preserve v10 and every earlier failure. No selection of configurations or solver tolerances by source HKLs, atomic-reference score or R1. The optimizer follows the prior algorithm family to remove the independently diagnosed shape-trajectory drift.

numerical_worker_import_policy: Reject scipy, h5py and hdf5plugin imports in both reduction and search workers; optional SciPy reference grading occurs in the parent after candidate save and worker exit.

execution_equivalence.policy: Fresh run and new output. Commit protocol before frames. Preserve all failed results. Each optimization stage has its own benchmark and full measured run; do not tune science controls or tolerances for speed.
execution_equivalence.memory_policy: 256 MiB additional geometry-cache cap, selected from measured 169.6 MiB capacity; no source intensities or atomic-reference scores select this resource cap.

archive_output.policy: Exact bytes; standard NPZ; exclusive create. Level 1 retains compression with about 6 percent larger files than NumPy level 6; uncompressed control retained in benchmark record but not selected.

null_rotations.provenance: Explicit frozen matrices from the existing NumPy default_rng(842025), 64 normalized quaternion samples; generated before any native replay. Native runtime does not require Python or random generator compatibility.

native_coordinator.policy: Retain scientific gates and all numerical differences. A faster run is not evidence of equivalence.
native_coordinator.execution: Ordered bounded source pipeline: two-frame/two-worker original preparation overlaps mask, detection and integration work; results/observer errors consumed in source order, pending count never exceeds owning stage workers, frames are never read after a source error. The same original-count and coarse DAC mask caches remain. Stage controls and complete 51-control search expansion are literal. All corrected trial-02 numerical arrays, candidate records and histories must match bitwise for this performance change. General native/Python parity still uses unchanged original numerical-equivalence limits, with any failed gate retained explicitly.
native_coordinator.block_expansion_execution: Replace per-detector-pixel coarse index division with full/partial row-block Boolean fills. Same coarse/provider/fixed-pixel union, no changed thresholds, footprint or angular semantics. A partial-edge/fixed-mask test and bitwise trial-04 replay gate cover this execution change.

space_group_search.catalogue: all 530 conventional Hall settings filtered by supplied cell metric; no exact space group or Laue prior
space_group_search.policy: No space-group absence filtering during prediction. All genuinely measured signed rows, including weak/negative rows, inform symmetry. Missing/masked rows never count as absent. Whole metric-orbit holdouts protect teachers/geometry before Laue assessment. Pre-empirical physical aperture intensities assess intensity symmetry; empirical scaling uses the reported provisional Laue hypothesis, never an exact space group. All settings retain diagnostics; bounded search explicitly reports untested alternatives, common-set model scores and ambiguity. No source HKL, CIF model/counts or reference score enters selection.

phase_screen.policy: One exact-group-free P1 phase map from the provisional rotational Laue hypothesis. Rank reasonable measured phase-origin settings before full element searches; retain absence diagnostics, rejected and untested settings. Reuse independently implemented phase-equivalence derivatives. No inferred decompiler equation or source code is translated.
phase_screen.execution_policy: At most four independent P1 starts concurrently. Each owns numerical buffers; results are consumed in original start order. No nested solution workers. Compare all phase histories, selected density and candidates against serial v32; no arithmetic/control changes.

space_group_search.shared_map_policy: Pass the same exact-group-free P1 map directly to existing symmetry-origin/recycling/element assignment and isotropic fitting for each candidate. Verify cell/elements/measurement identity. When no target model is found, allow independent phasing within remaining per-candidate and total budgets, retaining the better common-set model score and both attempt diagnostics. Known-group path unchanged. No reference or target-count selection.
